text: U.S. stock indices moved higher on Tuesday, with the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq Composite all posting gains as the market approached record highs. The rally was driven by strong corporate earnings from companies like Palantir and Caterpillar, as well as optimism regarding a potential U.S.-Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which helped ease oil prices and reduce market volatility. While broad market breadth remained positive with a majority of issues advancing, investors continued to monitor economic data, including a JOLTS report that showed resilient hiring.
